cards.notes: Rates tier with spend (1% first AED 3,000, 3% to 8,000, 5% above) in the two chosen categories; modelled at the top tier for all four, so only two apply. Utility and government payments through Al Hilal app earn nothing. Free for life. Official FAQ (read): two chosen categories, tiers by total monthly retail spend 1% to AED 3,000, 3% to 8,000, 5% above; cap AED 250 per chosen category and AED 500 total; other retail 1%; credited next month. Fee, min salary and FX not confirmed on official pages (fee schedule PDF layout unreadable; scheduled FX 2.89% for some Al Hilal cards), so confidence stays medium. KFS lists further Al Hilal covered cards (Elite World, World Emirati, World) not modelled.
